### [1] [EditHero: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Part-Level 3D Editing and Vibe Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02298)
*Ruihan Yu,Yu-Ju Tsai,Muyao Niu,Runyi Li,Lian Fu,Hanqing Liu,Zheng-Hui Huang,Yonghao Yu,Sho Kuno,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Kaipeng Zhang,Zhixiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EditHero 是首个针对长期、部件级 3D 编辑的基准，支持自然语言指令和目标图像，用于几何与纹理编辑。通过确定性装配引擎生成精确目标，并经人工审核。对比了自上而下（非代理）与自下而上（基于 LLM/VLM 的代理）两种方法：前者常遗漏修改且影响未编辑区域；后者更精准遵循指令并保持未编辑部分稳定，但每次编辑耗时数分钟。研究将公开引擎与编辑序列以推动可靠迭代 3D 编辑研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 3D 编辑方法多在单一编辑任务上测试，但实际资产构建涉及一系列连续修订，要求每次编辑仅改变指定部分而不影响其余内容。现有方法缺乏对长期迭代编辑的系统评估，亟需一个能真实反映复杂编辑流程的基准。

Method: 提出 EditHero 基准，包含由确定性装配引擎生成的多步编辑序列，每一步均有自然语言指令和目标图像（几何与纹理），所有序列均经人工审查确保准确性。采用两种典型编辑范式进行对比：非代理方法（自上而下，基于学习的 3D 表示重生成）与基于大模型（LLM/VLM）的代理方法（自下而上，通过代码分析网格并局部修改）。

Result: 非代理方法常遗漏请求更改，且误扰应保持不变的区域；基于 LLM/VLM 的代理方法更准确地遵循指令，有效保留未编辑部分，但单次编辑耗时长达数分钟。结果表明，尽管代理方法在保真度上更优，其效率仍有待提升。

Conclusion: EditHero 提供了一个真实、可复现的长期迭代 3D 编辑评估平台，揭示了当前主流方法在精度与效率上的权衡。未来研究需兼顾高保真与高效，推动更可靠的迭代 3D 内容创作。

Abstract: 3D editing methods are usually tested on a single edit, yet an asset is built through a long sequence of revisions, each of which must implement the requested change while leaving everything else unchanged. We introduce EditHero, to our knowledge the first benchmark for long-horizon, part-level 3D editing, with natural-language instructions and target images for both geometry and texture. A deterministic assembly engine produces the exact target after every edit, and every sequence is reviewed by hand. We use EditHero to compare 2 opposite approaches to 3D editing. Non-agentic methods operate top down, regenerating the object from a learned 3D representation and inferring what to keep. In contrast, LLM/VLM agents operate bottom up, editing through code that inspects the mesh and rewrites only the parts required by instructions. The non-agentic methods often miss the requested change and disturb regions that should stay fixed. Most LLMs follow instructions more closely, and all of them preserve the unedited parts better, but each of their edits takes minutes. We will release the engine and the edit sequences to support research on reliable iterative 3D editing.

</details>


### [2] [DeskForge: Dense Supervision from Desktop Environments for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02320)
*A. Said Gurbuz,Ahmed Nassar,Sunghwan Hong,Marc Pollefeys,Peter W. J. Staar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DeskForge，一个可控制的桌面环境，用于生成大规模、密集标注的计算机使用场景数据。通过组合真实应用并控制其状态、布局、外观等，生成1.2M标注观测样本（含159.7M元素实例），构建了DeskForge-1M数据集。在该数据上微调四个视觉语言模型后，所有模型在跨域桌面条件和外部GUI接地基准测试中表现均提升，如Qwen3.5-4B在ScreenSpot-Pro和OSWorld-G上分别提升11.51%和10.11%。长周期任务完成率也显著提高，例如在WebArena-Infinity任务中从31提升至50/119。结果表明，可控桌面环境是提升GUI接地与复杂任务执行能力的有效监督来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练数据缺乏对复杂桌面场景的密集标注，且难以系统性地变化场景要素，导致计算机使用代理在真实桌面环境中难以可靠识别操作目标。需要一种能生成大规模、多样化、带密集标注的真实桌面场景数据的方法。

Method: 构建DeskForge环境，通过组合真实应用程序并动态调整其状态、内容、窗口布局、外观和分辨率，自动生成包含截图、可访问性树和窗口几何信息的密集元素标注，并记录每个动作的结果，形成大规模标注数据集DeskForge-1M。在此基础上，选取20万样本微调四个视觉语言模型。

Result: 微调后的模型在多个外部GUI接地基准测试中性能显著提升，如Qwen3.5-4B在ScreenSpot-Pro和OSWorld-G上准确率分别提升11.51%和10.11%；长周期任务完成率明显改善，如在WebArena-Infinity中任务解决数从31增至50，在OpenApps中从3增至15。

Conclusion: 可控合成真实桌面环境能够提供可扩展的大规模监督信号，有效提升计算机使用代理在GUI接地和长周期任务中的表现，为未来智能自动化系统提供了重要数据与方法支持。项目代码、数据集和微调模型已公开。

Abstract: Computer-use agents need to reliably ground action targets in complex desktop scenes, where multiple applications, overlapping windows, and visually similar controls compete for attention. Existing training data rarely pair such scenes with dense annotations or vary them in a controlled way. We introduce DeskForge, a controllable desktop environment that composes and explores real applications to generate large-scale supervision for computer-use agents. It varies application states, content, window layout, appearance, and resolution, and fuses screenshots, accessibility trees, and window geometry into dense element annotations while recording the outcome of each executed action. Using this environment, we construct DeskForge-1M, a corpus of 1.2M annotated desktop observations containing 159.7M element instances. We fine-tune four vision-language models on 200K grounding examples drawn from DeskForge-1M. All four improve across held-out desktop conditions and on all five external GUI grounding benchmarks; for Qwen3.5-4B, accuracy increases by 11.51 percentage points on ScreenSpot-Pro and 10.11 points on OSWorld-G. The gains also translate to long-horizon task completion: under a fixed planner, the fine-tuned action models solve more WebArena-Infinity and OpenApps tasks, with Qwen3.5-4B increasing from 31 to 50 of 119 tasks and from 3 to 15 of 100 tasks, respectively. These results show that controllable composition of real desktop environments provides a scalable source of supervision for improving both GUI grounding and long-horizon computer use. The framework code, the dataset, and the fine-tuned model are available from the project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/

</details>


### [3] [SCION: Scene Composition with Instanced Neural Primitives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02322)
*William Koch,Amogh Joshi,Cyrus Vachha,Cheng Zheng,Felix Heide*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SCION提出一种分层的组合式场景表示方法，通过引入可重用的原型和轻量级实例来替代独立的高斯分布，实现紧凑且可控的3D场景建模。该方法结合离散与连续参数的联合优化，利用两阶段密集化和对抗损失，在保持高质量的同时大幅降低存储开销（低至1.2MB），并支持无需重新训练的实例级编辑与动画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经场景表示方法将场景元素视为独立个体，导致参数冗余、难以控制。虽然部分方法尝试使用模板对象，但依赖人工选择重复元素，限制了自动化与可扩展性。因此，亟需一种能自动发现并利用重复结构的高效、可操控的场景表示框架。

Method: SCION采用分层结构：以少量可重用的原型（primitives）构成词汇表，并通过世界空间中的实例（instances）放置其变换后的副本。通过联合优化离散（实例位置、类型）与连续（形状、颜色等）参数，结合两层级密集化策略和对抗损失，实现对多视角图像数据的拟合。

Result: SCION在保持高保真度的前提下，显著压缩了场景表示体积（最低达1.2MB），优于现有高斯压缩方法的率失真性能；同时支持实例级别的编辑与动画，无需重新训练。实验表明，神经场景表示可通过发现可重用组件实现高效建模。

Conclusion: 神经场景表示无需将每个元素当作独立实体进行记忆，而是可以通过自动识别和复用共性结构，构建更紧凑、可控制的组合式表示。这为高效三维场景建模与交互提供了新范式。

Abstract: Real-world scenes are compositional: bricks, blades of grass, pebbles, and tree leaves recur across human-built and natural environments. Existing neural scene representations model these elements independently. Most 3D Gaussian Splatting and follow-up abstraction and compression methods treat each element as unique, fitting millions of independent Gaussians per scene. Prior methods like Splat and Replace fit template objects, but they require mostly manual selection of repeated elements. As a result, these representations store redundant parameters and provide weak manipulation handles for downstream tasks. We introduce SCION, a hier- archical compositional scene representation that replaces independent Gaussians with a compact vocabulary of reusable primitives and lightweight world-space instances that place transformed copies throughout the scene. We fit this represen- tation to multi-view captures via a joint optimization over discrete and continuous scene parameters, combining two-level densification over splats and instances with an adversarial loss that preserves detail across shared primitives. The recovered structure yields a compact, controllable representation while maintaining high quality even at 1.2 MB. SCION achieves rate-distortion favorable to existing Gaussian compression methods, and it enables instance-level scene editing and animation without retraining. Our results show that neural scene representations need not memorize scenes as independent primitives; they can discover reusable parts. Project webpage: https://light.princeton.edu/SCION

</details>


### [4] [SCOPE-4D: Endoscopic 4D Geometry Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02343)
*Chaoyi Zhou,Zhongpai Gao,Anwesa Choudhuri,Meng Zheng,Benjamin Planche,Run Wang,Terrence Chen,Siyu Huang,Ziyan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE-4D，一个端到端的内窥镜4D几何基础模型，可从单目RGB视频中联合预测相机参数、密集几何结构和3D组织轨迹。通过构建SCOPE-5K数据集（约5000个真实与合成的胃肠镜及腹腔镜视频片段），提供丰富的几何监督信号，并引入共残差运动（CRM）约束以减少局部形变干扰，显著提升相机与深度估计精度，同时实现高精度3D组织追踪。在多个公开及自建基准上验证了其在域内与域外场景下的优越性能，尤其在长序列结肠重建中表现稳定，且盲测用户研究证实其重建质量可信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内窥镜导航与机器人辅助依赖于准确的几何理解，但面临两大挑战：几何标注稀缺，以及相机运动与组织形变之间的混淆。现有方法难以同时精确估计几何结构与组织动态，亟需大规模标注数据与有效运动建模机制。

Method: 提出SCOPE-4D模型，基于单目视频进行联合推理；构建SCOPE-5K数据集，涵盖真实与合成内窥镜视频；采用几何监督微调学习内窥镜先验；引入共残差运动（CRM）约束，使局部形变相对于整体组织运动保持一致；结合几何与轨迹监督，实现高精度相机、深度与组织轨迹估计。

Result: 在多个公共与新收集的基准上，模型在几何估计、3D组织追踪与长序列结肠重建方面均表现出色，优于现有方法；盲测用户研究显示其重建结果在临床视频中具有较高感知质量。

Conclusion: 大规模内窥镜几何监督与运动约束对联合几何估计与组织追踪具有关键价值，所提出的框架为内窥镜视觉理解提供了坚实基础。

Abstract: Geometric understanding supports endoscopic navigation and robotic assistance, but learning reliable endoscopic geometry faces two challenges: scarce geometric annotations and ambiguity between camera motion and tissue deformation. We present SCOPE-4D, an endoscopic 4D geometry foundation model that jointly predicts camera parameters, dense geometry, and 3D tissue trajectories from monocular RGB video in a single forward pass. Our curation and annotation pipeline constructs SCOPE-5K, a collection of approximately 5,000 clips spanning real and synthetic gastrointestinal endoscopy and laparoscopy. The collection provides rich geometric supervision and includes newly collected phantom and real-colonoscopy evaluation sets. Geometric supervised fine-tuning on SCOPE-5K learns endoscopic priors that improve camera and depth estimation. Common--Residual Motion (CRM) further constrains local deformation relative to common tissue movement. Together with geometric supervision, CRM and trajectory supervision further improve camera and depth estimation over geometric fine-tuning alone while enabling dense 3D tissue tracking. Evaluations on public and newly collected benchmarks demonstrate strong in-domain and out-of-domain geometry, superior 3D tracking, and more stable long-sequence colon reconstruction. A blinded user study further supports the perceived reconstruction quality on real clinical video. Together, these results demonstrate the value of large-scale endoscopic supervision and motion constraints for joint geometry estimation and tissue tracking.

</details>


### [5] [Confidence-Controlled XAI Auditing for Pedestrian Detection under Domain Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02364)
*Ruben Dario Florez-Zela*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究审计了固定YOLOv8s行人检测器在PIE和JAAD数据集上基于ROI的D-Deletion、冻结置信度三分位数、基于排名的测试、自助区间和Holm校正的后处理解释。结果显示，删除法的忠实性与解释时的检测强度高度相关（斯皮尔曼相关系数0.70-0.82），导致简单的置信度分层比较不可靠。在控制检测强度后，D-RISE的忠实性仍表现出域依赖性，在中央f0范围内PIE的D-Deletion高于JAAD且经Holm校正显著。非扰动的EigenCAM基线比D-RISE更不忠实，但也存在得分耦合现象，表明该效应并非D-RISE特有，而是与基于删除的评估设置有关。研究呼吁在领域变化下对安全关键感知进行置信度控制的XAI审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释性在智能车辆感知模型中日益重要，但其在驾驶领域变化下的忠实性仍不清楚。现有方法在不同域间的表现差异可能源于检测强度的影响，因此需要更严谨的评估框架来确保解释的可靠性。

Method: 采用基于ROI的D-Deletion、冻结置信度三分位数、秩次测试、自助区间和Holm校正等方法，对YOLOv8s行人检测器在PIE和JAAD两个数据集上的后处理解释进行系统性审计。通过控制检测强度，分析解释忠实性在不同域间的差异。

Result: 删除法的忠实性与检测强度强相关（Spearman相关系数0.70–0.82），导致常规置信度分层比较不可靠；在控制检测强度后，D-RISE的忠实性仍呈现域依赖性，PIE表现优于JAAD且经Holm校正显著；非扰动EigenCAM也显示得分耦合，说明该现象与评估方法有关而非特定算法。

Conclusion: 在领域变化下，解释的忠实性受检测强度影响显著，应采用置信度控制的XAI审计方法以保障安全关键感知系统的可解释性可靠性。

Abstract: Explainability is increasingly required for perception models in intelligent vehicles, yet whether explanations remain faithful under driving domain shift is still poorly understood. This work audits post-hoc explanations of a fixed YOLOv8s pedestrian detector across PIE and JAAD using ROI-based D-Deletion, frozen confidence terciles, rank-based tests, bootstrap intervals, and Holm correction. The audit shows that deletion-based faithfulness is strongly coupled to detection strength at explanation time, with Spearman correlations between 0.70 and 0.82 for D-RISE, making naive confidence-stratified comparisons unreliable. After controlling for detection strength within fixed f0 bins, D-RISE faithfulness remains domain-dependent in the central f0 range, with PIE showing higher D-Deletion than JAAD and Holm-adjusted significance. A non-perturbative EigenCAM baseline is less faithful than D-RISE but also exhibits score coupling, suggesting that the effect is not specific to D-RISE and is related to the deletion-based evaluation setup. These results motivate confidence-controlled XAI audits for safety-critical perception under domain shift.

</details>


### [6] [EviDent-CBCT: Evidence-Bottlenecked Report Generation from Dental CBCT under Non-Exhaustive Report Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02375)
*Ruiyang Hao,Zhi Qin Tan,Yulan He,Owen Addison,Yunpeng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EviDent-CBCT 是一种针对不完整监督下牙颌锥形束 CT（CBCT）报告生成的证据瓶颈框架。它通过解剖感知网络将扫描映射为牙齿级别、全局和牙槽嵴动脉孔（IAC）的离散证据记录，再经牙科逻辑一致性投影修正矛盾证据，最后由确定性渲染器与图像无关的局部语言模型生成报告。针对牙齿级证据，采用可靠性感知训练，将可验证的未提及项作为低权重负样本；未报告的全局和牙槽嵴动脉孔标签则保持未知。金属敏感输入通道保留了牙科材料的强度线索。在三次验证中，该方法在合并证据集F1上达到 $0.666\pm0.006$，在RadFact-Lite-Dental逻辑F1上达到 $0.402\pm0.003$，显著优于最强基线（$0.371\pm0.018$）。在ODIN 2026挑战赛中，其自动评估排名第二，临床盲评排名第三。结果表明，离散证据记录是有效且可审计的CBCT报告生成接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBCT报告包含大量牙齿特异性、解剖和空间发现，但常规报告往往不完全记录所有影像发现，未提及可能意味着不存在或未报告，导致学习生成报告面临不完整监督的挑战。因此需要一种能处理这种信息缺失并保证逻辑一致性的方法。

Method: 提出EviDent-CBCT框架，包括：1）解剖感知网络，将每张CBCT扫描转化为牙齿级别、全局和牙槽嵴动脉孔（IAC）的离散证据记录；2）牙科逻辑一致性投影，用于修正不兼容证据；3）确定性渲染器与图像无关的局部语言模型，基于证据记录生成报告；4）可靠性感知训练策略，对可验证的非提及项赋予较低权重的负样本；5）金属敏感输入通道，保留牙科材料的强度信息。

Result: 在三个验证运行中，EviDent-CBCT在合并证据集F1上达到 $0.666\pm0.006$，在RadFact-Lite-Dental逻辑F1上达到 $0.402\pm0.003$，显著优于最强直接基线（$0.371\pm0.018$）。在ODIN 2026挑战赛中，自动评估排名第二，临床盲评排名第三。证明了离散证据记录在报告生成中的有效性与可审计性。

Conclusion: EviDent-CBCT通过构建离散证据记录，有效应对了CBCT报告生成中的不完整监督问题，实现了高准确率与逻辑一致性，为自动化医学影像报告生成提供了一种可靠、可解释的技术路径。

Abstract: Dento-maxillofacial cone-beam CT (CBCT) reports may contain dozens of tooth-specific, anatomical, and spatial findings from a single 3D scan. Learning to generate such reports from limited clinical data is challenging because routine reports may not exhaustively document image findings, and a non-mention may reflect either absence or non-reporting. We present EviDent-CBCT, an evidence-bottlenecked framework designed for this incomplete supervision. An anatomy-aware network maps each CBCT scan to a discrete record of tooth-level, global, and tooth-IAC evidence. A dental-logic consistency projection reconciles incompatible evidence before a deterministic renderer and an image-blind local language model generate the report using only this record. For tooth-level evidence, reliability-aware training uses eligible non-mentions as reduced-weight negatives, while unreported global and tooth-IAC labels remain unknown. A metal-sensitive input channel preserves intensity cues from dental materials. Across three validation runs, EviDent-CBCT achieves $0.666\pm0.006$ merged evidence set-F1 and $0.402\pm0.003$ RadFact-Lite-Dental logical-F1, versus $0.371\pm0.018$ for the strongest controlled direct baseline. In the ODIN 2026 challenge, it ranked second in automated evaluation and third in blinded clinical Arena comparison on the hidden test set. These results support the discrete evidence record as an effective and auditable interface for CBCT report generation.

</details>


### [7] [FactorSplat: Appearance-Controllable Gaussian Proxies for Medical Volume Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02382)
*Zhongpai Gao,Benjamin Planche,Meng Zheng,Anwesa Choudhuri,Terrence Chen,Ziyan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FactorSplat 是一种新的基于高斯点云的医学体积渲染方法，通过引入可变的转移函数（TFs）实现区域特定的颜色和透明度控制。它利用局部查找与共享功能编码器及低秩因子结合的方式，在不重新训练的情况下支持未见编辑，显著提升渲染质量与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于图像训练的高斯代理将单一转移函数固化在其外观中，限制了对不同区域颜色和透明度的灵活控制；需要一种能支持动态、区域化转移函数调整的方法以增强医学影像可视化能力。

Method: 提出N维高斯点云（N-DGS）代理FactorSplat，通过局部查找应用用户定义的强度到RGBA曲线，结合共享功能编码器与低秩每高斯因子建模残差外观响应，同时保持几何和方向性外观一致性，支持可见性控制与TF感知剪枝。

Conclusion: FactorSplat实现了高效、灵活且高质量的医学体积渲染，支持无重训练的区域自适应转移函数编辑，为交互式医学可视化提供了强大工具。

Abstract: Transfer functions (TFs) control color and visibility in medical volume rendering, but image-trained Gaussian proxies typically bake one transfer function into their appearance. We present FactorSplat, a per-scene N-dimensional Gaussian splatting (N-DGS) proxy that accepts region-specific intensity-to-RGBA curves at inference. A local lookup applies the authored color and opacity change, while a shared functional encoder and low-rank per-Gaussian factors learn the residual appearance response. Geometry and directional appearance remain shared across presets, with visibility control and TF-aware pruning preserving the ability to hide and reveal structures. On seven CT and MR scans, FactorSplat improves mean PSNR and changed-region error over region-aware VEG across validation, interpolation, unseen composition, and out-of-distribution (OOD) edits. Across these four splits, seven-scan mean PSNR gains over VEG range from 1.10 to 1.52 dB. One checkpoint per scan supports unseen edits without retraining. At $1600^2$, the cached fast renderer averages 524 FPS with 1.17 ms TF switches. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/FactorSplat/.

</details>


### [8] [Octrees as an Explicit 3D Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02388)
*Ran Dan,Si-Tong Wei,Pengfei Xiong,Wei Zhang,Yadong Mu,Peng-Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OctLLM introduces a novel 3D LLM architecture that preserves spatial structure using Sparse Octree (S-Octree) tokens and maintains general language ability by adding 3D capacity via separate, trainable branches without modifying the frozen backbone. It achieves state-of-the-art performance in 3D understanding and generation while minimizing parameter updates.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing 3D LLMs either lose spatial structure through compression or degrade general language capability due to full fine-tuning. This work aims to preserve geometry-awareness and maintain pre-trained language abilities.

Method: OctLLM uses explicit 3D sequences of octree occupancy tokens, employs random pruning at penultimate levels to create Sparse Octrees for efficient representation, and integrates 3D modality through independent, trainable branches in select blocks while keeping the original language pathway frozen. Cross-modal interaction is enabled via shared self-attention.

Result: OctLLM reduces image-to-3D FID by 17.4% and improves render-grounded captioning by 28.7 points over ShapeLLM-Omni, while matching the backbone's performance on general language benchmarks.

Conclusion: OctLLM effectively balances 3D geometric fidelity and general language capability by decoupling 3D processing from the core language model, enabling efficient training and superior multimodal performance.

Abstract: Existing 3D large language models (LLMs) compromise on two fronts: they compress shapes into latent codebook indices or coordinate text, which removes spatial structure from what the model observes, and they acquire the 3D modality by fine-tuning the backbone, which overwrites its general language ability. We present OctLLM, which addresses both limitations. Geometry enters as an explicit 3D sequence of octree occupancy tokens. However, full octree sequences grow rapidly with depth; OctLLM therefore randomly empties penultimate-level nodes and omits descendants while preserving shape, yielding a shorter coordinate- and depth-anchored Sparse Octree (S-Octree) for position-aware mask-modeling generation and 3D understanding. On the other front, existing methods introduce a new modality with full fine-tuning or LoRA, but full fine-tuning is costly, LoRA limits 3D capacity, and both modify the language pathway. OctLLM instead adds 3D capacity in parameters separate from the pretrained ones: mesh tokens are routed through independent trainable branches in a subset of blocks while text and image tokens retain the frozen vision-language pathway, and the two streams interact through shared self-attention. It trains far fewer parameters than full fine-tuning, yet sets a new state of the art among unified multimodal LLMs, lowering image-to-3D FID by $17.4\%$ and raising render-grounded captioning by $28.7$ points over ShapeLLM-Omni, while matching the backbone on general language benchmarks.

</details>

Abstract: Androgenetic alopecia (AGA) is characterized by patterned follicular miniaturization, increased single-hair follicular units, and altered hair-shaft diameter. We present an automated quantitative scalp-analysis and clinical decision-support framework combining FU localization, ordinal visible-shaft counting, calibrated shaft-width estimation, regional aggregation, and an interpretable rule layer. The clinical cohort comprised 243 patients (127 AGA, 116 non-AGA), while the computer-vision experiments used 160 expert-annotated patients, 2,400 trichoscopic images, and approximately 158,000 FU annotations. Under patientdisjoint evaluation, YOLOv8m achieved test mAP@0.5=0.920 and recall=0.860; EfficientNet-B5 with a support-map channel achieved 87.0% expert-box count accuracy (macro F1=0.85). A separate 500-image set was processed end-to-end with detector-generated boxes, yielding MAE of 6.56 for follicle detection and 16.59 for follicle classification relative to human-expert annotations. The system is intended to assist, rather than replace, dermatologist interpretation.

</details>


### [10] [A Simulation-Grounded Agentic VLM Framework for Wildfire Monitoring and Reporting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02451)
*Duowen Chen,Yuchen Sun,Zhiqi Li,Yuxuan Liao,Sinan Wang,Bart van Bloemen Waanders,Bo Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于模拟的视觉-语言模型（VLM）框架，将2D野火模拟自动转换为带标签的视频片段。通过固定Blender映射生成与模拟地形、燃料分布、火势活动和风向线索对齐的低细节3D代理，再利用可控视频生成增强视觉表现。这些代理作为中间表示，不追求精细渲染。生成的视频与模拟标签共同构成可复用的多模态记忆，支持无训练的多智能体VLM系统，实现参考片段检索、视觉与记忆预测融合，并生成结构化野火报告。在未见生成片段上，视频记忆达到51.5%的四标签精确率，显著优于直接VLM查询（22.6%）和纯文本记忆（16-17%）；完整系统在六个模拟衍生报告字段上达到77.3%准确率。通过组件消融、跨生成器测试和三次真实无人机评估，验证了检索、报告、生成器变化及可观测监测任务的性能。该框架实现了从自动模拟到代理转换，再到稀缺真实物理标注下的记忆式VLM推理的连接。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 采用固定Blender映射生成低细节3D代理，对齐模拟器中的地形、燃料布局、火势活动和风向信息；通过可控视频生成技术丰富视觉外观；构建由生成视频与模拟标签组成的多模态记忆库；设计无需训练的多智能体VLM系统，利用记忆进行参考片段检索、视觉与记忆预测融合，生成结构化报告。

Conclusion: 本框架成功实现了从自动模拟到代理转换，再到基于记忆的视觉-语言推理的闭环，有效缓解了真实物理标注稀缺的问题，为野火监测提供了可扩展、低成本且高性能的解决方案。

Abstract: Effective wildfire monitoring requires relating visual evidence to physical fire dynamics, yet real videos with synchronized physical annotations are scarce and high-fidelity 3D simulation is costly. We present a simulation-grounded vision-language model (VLM) framework that automatically converts 2D wildfire simulations into labeled video episodes. A fixed Blender mapping produces low-detail 3D proxies aligned with simulator terrain, fuel layout, fire activity, and wind cues; controllable video generation supplies richer appearance. The proxies are intermediate representations rather than finely rendered final scenes. Generated videos and simulator labels form reusable multimodal memory for a training-free multi-agent VLM system that retrieves reference episodes, reconciles visual and memory-based predictions, and produces structured wildfire reports. On held-out generated episodes, video memory achieves 51.5% exact four-tag accuracy, compared with 22.6% for direct VLM querying and 16-17% for text-only memory; the complete system achieves 77.3% accuracy on six simulator-derived report fields. Component ablations, cross-generator tests, and three real-UAV evaluations assess retrieval, reporting, generator changes, and observable monitoring tasks. The framework connects automatic simulation-to-proxy conversion with memory-based VLM reasoning under scarce real-world physical annotations.

</details>

*Aniq Ahmad,Musham Ahmad Malik,Ahmad Mustafa,Heather Bedle*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于坐标回归的地震层位追踪方法，替代传统的语义分割。通过轻量级回归头与LSTM模块建模跨剖面上下文，直接预测每个横向位置的层位时间/深度坐标，避免了前后处理误差。结合L1/L2损失与地质先验正则化，提升模型对稀疏标注的鲁棒性，并实现连续层位表面生成。实验表明，该方法在新西兰地震数据集上优于现有分割方法，在RMSE、PCC等指标上表现更优，且可自动识别地质复杂度变化，提供质量控制依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统深度学习方法将层位追踪视为密集语义分割任务，需进行前后处理，易引入误差；且2D模型缺乏跨剖面上下文，3D模型计算成本高。同时，未标记的地震道被当作背景，影响模型收敛。因此需要一种更高效、准确并能捕捉空间连续性的新方法。

Method: 将层位追踪建模为有界坐标回归问题，采用预训练视觉骨干网络，搭配轻量级回归头和LSTM模块以建模跨剖面依赖关系，直接输出每个横向位置的时间/深度坐标。使用L1和L2损失监督有效拾取点，引入地质启发式正则化确保横向连续性。

Result: 在新西兰地震数据集上的实验显示，所提方法在定量指标（如RMSE、PCC）上持续优于分割方法，且对训练拾取稀疏性具有更强鲁棒性。此外，相邻剖面预测差异可反映局部地质复杂度，可用于自动化质量控制。

Conclusion: 提出的坐标回归框架有效解决了传统分割方法的局限性，实现了更精确、鲁棒且无需后处理的层位追踪，同时具备潜在的地质解释辅助能力。

Abstract: Automatic horizon tracking is a foundational task in 3D seismic interpretation. Most existing deep learning approaches formulate it as dense semantic segmentation, typically using U-Net-based architectures. The model produces a probability map over all pixels that must be post-processed to extract precise horizon coordinates, while horizon picks in time/depth must be converted into dense masks for training. Unpicked seismic traces are consequently treated as background, which can hinder convergence, and both pre- and post-processing can introduce errors into the final interpretation. Moreover, 2D segmentation models do not inherently capture inter-slice context, while 3D models are often computationally prohibitive. We instead formulate horizon tracking as a bounded coordinate regression problem, where the model directly predicts the time/depth coordinate of the target horizon at each lateral position. We propose a lightweight regression head compatible with any pretrained vision backbone, coupled with an LSTM module to model inter-slice context and produce a continuous horizon surface across the volume. A combination of L1 and L2 losses supervises predictions at valid horizon picks, while a geology-informed regularization enforces lateral continuity between successive traces. Under controlled experimental conditions, we evaluate four pretrained vision backbones under both segmentation and regression configurations on a seismic volume from New Zealand. The proposed approach consistently outperforms its segmentation counterparts quantitatively, using metrics including RMSE and PCC, and qualitatively, while also demonstrating greater robustness to increasing sparsity of training picks. Finally, we show that prediction variation across successive traces captures local variations in geological complexity, providing an automated quality control measure for downstream seismic interpretation.

</details>


### [12] [MeshQuery: Agentic Seam Planning for UV Parametrization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02507)
*Marco Schouten,Arthur Roullier,Elie Michel,Ruben Wiersma,Axel Paris,Tamy Boubekeur*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MeshQuery 是一种无需训练的智能代理方法，用于自动对生产级四边形网格进行 UV 展开。它利用视觉语言模型（VLM）在自然语言指导和反馈循环下规划符合艺术家意图的接缝，通过可查询的网格表示和领域特定语言（DSL）实现对网格信息的按需检索、紧凑的接缝规划以及基于 UV 质量反馈的迭代优化。在 Adobe Substance 3D 和 Toys4K 数据集上，其结果比最强基线减少 2.9 倍/4.29 倍的图块数、接缝长度缩短 1.63 倍/1.7 倍，且专业艺术家在 80.9% 的对比中更偏好其结果。该方法通过解耦高层意图规划与底层边选择，并采用紧凑的网格表示，支持在不同 VLM 后端运行，并能处理比自回归接缝预测大一个数量级的网格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 UV 展开方法依赖人工或复杂模型，难以兼顾自动化与艺术质量；现有自动方法在图块数量、接缝长度和艺术一致性方面表现不佳。因此需要一种无需训练、能理解人类意图并生成高质量接缝方案的通用自动化工具。

Method: 提出 MeshQuery 方法，结合可查询网格表示与领域特定语言（DSL），使 VLM 能基于自然语言指令和反馈循环，通过一系列边选择操作（基于拓扑、几何、语义属性）规划接缝。使用迭代反馈机制优化接缝方案以提升 UV 质量。

Result: 在 Adobe Substance 3D 和 Toys4K 数据集上，相比最强基线，图块数减少 2.9 倍/4.29 倍，接缝长度缩短 1.63 倍/1.7 倍；专业艺术家在 80.9% 的对比中更偏好其结果；支持跨 VLM 运行，可处理比自回归方法大一个数量级的网格。

Conclusion: MeshQuery 成功实现了无需训练的、基于自然语言意图的高效自动 UV 展开，显著提升了结果质量与可扩展性，为工业级建模工作流提供了强有力的新范式。

Abstract: We present MeshQuery, a training-free agentic approach to automatic UV unwrapping of production-grade quad meshes. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) plans artist-aligned seams using a set of edge-selection tools, conditioned on domain-specific UV-unwrapping knowledge expressed in natural language and refined with a feedback loop. We design a queryable mesh representation together with a domain-specific language (DSL) that enables the agent to retrieve mesh information on demand, express a seam plan as a compact program of edge-selection operators over topological, geometric, and semantic mesh attributes, and iteratively refine it from UV quality feedback. On Adobe Substance 3D and Toys4K meshes, MeshQuery produces 2.9x/4.29x fewer charts and 1.63x/1.7x shorter seams than the strongest baseline, and professional artists prefer its results in 80.9% of comparisons. Ultimately, decoupling high-level intent planning from low-level edge selection and compact mesh representation lets MeshQuery run on different backend VLMs and scale to meshes an order of magnitude larger than autoregressive seam prediction

</details>


### [13] [From Fragments to Global Maps: Learning Vectorized Map Aggregation with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02513)
*Ziwei Li,Yi-Tang Chen,Xiaoqi Wang,Wenbin He,Han-Wei Shen,Liu Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MapMergeLLM提出一种基于大语言模型的数据驱动框架，将矢量地图聚合问题转化为条件序列生成任务，通过合成数据和几何感知的坐标标记器实现对局部地图片段的高效整合，显著优于传统启发式与优化方法，且无需针对特定检测器重新训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地图聚合方法依赖手工规则，难以适应不同道路结构和预测误差，需针对具体检测器调参或人工调整，缺乏通用性。

Method: 采用大语言模型进行条件序列生成，将局部矢量地图序列转换为全局地图；使用合成数据模拟预测误差进行训练；引入几何感知的坐标标记器；设计线级关联损失以显式监督同一地图元素的对应关系。

Result: 在Argoverse2和nuScenes数据集上，使用多个最新上游检测器验证，MapMergeLLM显著优于基于启发式和优化的基线方法，且无需特定检测器再训练。

Conclusion: MapMergeLLM实现了高效、通用且鲁棒的地图聚合，为自动驾驶中的高精地图构建提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large-scale vectorized HD maps provide structured road information that is essential for perception, localization, and planning in autonomous driving. Constructing such maps requires aggregating noisy, fragmented, and overlapping local predictions collected along a vehicle trajectory into a coherent global map. Existing aggregation methods typically rely on hand-crafted rules for fragment association and refinement. However, a fixed set of thresholds cannot effectively handle variations in road structures and prediction errors, often requiring detector-specific tuning or manual adjustment. To address this limitation, we propose MapMergeLLM, a data-driven framework that formulates vectorized map aggregation as conditional sequence generation with a large language model. Given serialized local vectorized maps, our model directly predicts the aggregated global map polylines. To reduce dependence on any particular upstream detector, we train the model on synthetic local maps generated from clean vector maps using corruptions that simulate representative prediction errors. We further introduce a coordinate tokenizer with geometry-aware pretraining to precisely represent map coordinates. In addition, we propose a line-level association loss that explicitly supervises correspondences between local observations of the same map element. Experiments on Argoverse2 and nuScenes using multiple recent upstream detectors demonstrate that MapMergeLLM substantially outperforms heuristic and optimization-based aggregation baselines without detector-specific retraining.

</details>


### [14] [Spatial Memory Intelligence: Endowing World Models with Understanding-Driven Long-Term Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02521)
*Ying Yang,Guiyu Zhang,Lianghua Huang,Chang Nie,Chenyang Si,Haofan Wang,Shaoshuai Shi,Li Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI)框架，利用多模态大模型的空间推理能力，系统化管理长视频世界模型中的空间记忆。引入四种协同原子操作：空间聚类、组内稀疏化、动作感知检索和可靠性感知过滤，显著提升记忆稀疏性、生成稳定性和空间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频生成和世界模型在交互娱乐和具身模拟中具有潜力，但随着记忆序列变长和结构复杂，长程空间上下文管理面临挑战，亟需更智能的内存管理策略。

Method: 基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的空间推理能力，提出SMI框架，通过空间聚类、组内稀疏化、动作感知检索和可靠性感知过滤四种操作实现对空间记忆的系统化管理。

Result: 在多个基线、基准测试和世界模型骨干网络上进行的广泛实验表明，SMI在记忆稀疏性、生成稳定性及空间一致性方面均取得全面改进，展现出良好的有效性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: SMI是首个系统性利用理解模型进行空间记忆管理的框架，为长视频世界模型中的长期记忆管理提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Long-video generation and world models have shown strong potential for interactive entertainment and embodied simulation by predicting future observations conditioned on user actions and historical memory. However, as memory sequences grow longer and their structures become increasingly complex, managing long-range spatial context becomes increasingly challenging, calling for a more intelligent and systematic memory-management strategy. Building on the advancing spatial reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and the broader vision of unified models, we propose Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI), the first framework to systematically employ an understanding model for spatial-memory management in long-video world models. SMI introduces four coordinated atomic operations: spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability-aware filtering. Extensive experiments across multiple baselines, benchmarks, and world-model backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of SMI, achieving comprehensive improvements in memory sparsity, generation stability, and spatial consistency.

### [15] [Oracle headroom without signal: null-calibrated evaluation of candidate selection for thermal heart rate estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02561)
*Mohammad Rakibur Rahman,Nhi Nguyen,Sasan Sharifipour,Le Nguyen,Manuel Lage Cañellas,Miguel Bordallo López,Constantino Álvarez Casado*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了基于摄像头的生理监测中，信号质量指数在无参考情况下选择可靠估计值的潜力。通过模拟发现，当有K个独立候选信号时，理想选择器（oracle）的误差随1/K下降。在96个iBVP数据集上，对每10秒窗口的168个候选信号进行热心率估计，结果显示理想选择器均方误差仅为0.91 bpm，远优于固定配置（10.74 bpm）、最佳质量指标（18.03 bpm）和恒定预测器（8.61 bpm）。当K=24时，另一记录中的额部信号与正确信号匹配，误差分别为4.62与4.61 bpm。研究建议在报告理想选择器评估结果时应包括候选数量、有效覆盖率和匹配的零假设对照。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有信号质量指数在缺乏生理参考的情况下评估可靠性时，常使用理想选择器（oracle）来选取最接近真实值的估计，但这种做法可能因随机匹配而产生误导性结果，因此需要分析其潜在偏差并提出更严谨的评估方法。

Method: 采用顺序统计学建模，分析在无相关性的K个独立候选信号下，理想选择器的期望误差变化规律；在96个iBVP数据集上，对每10秒窗口生成168个候选信号，比较不同方法的性能，并引入零假设对照以验证结果的稳健性。

Result: 理想选择器的均方误差显著低于其他方法，仅0.91 bpm，表明其表现依赖于候选数量；当候选数为24时，另一记录的额部信号几乎与正确信号等效，误差仅差0.01 bpm；研究强调必须报告候选数量、有效覆盖率及零假设对照以避免误判。

Conclusion: 理想选择器评估易受随机匹配影响，必须报告候选数量、有效覆盖范围和零假设对照，否则可能导致对算法性能的高估。应谨慎使用此类评估方式，确保结果的可解释性和科学性。

Abstract: Camera-based physiological monitoring can produce multiple estimates from several facial regions, extraction methods, and processing settings. Signal quality indices aim to select reliable estimates without a physiological reference, and their potential is often assessed with an oracle that selects the estimate closest to the reference in each window. This retrospective selection can reward chance agreement. We model the effect with order statistics. For K independent candidates unrelated to the reference, the expected oracle error decreases approximately as 1/K. We analyze thermal heart rate estimation on 96 iBVP recordings with 168 candidates per 10 s window. The oracle achieves a mean absolute error of 0.91 bpm, compared with 10.74 bpm for the best fixed configuration, 18.03 bpm for the best quality index, and 8.61 bpm for a constant predictor. With K = 24, a forehead signal from another recording matches the correct one, with 4.62 against 4.61 bpm. Oracle evaluations should report candidate count, valid coverage, and matched null controls.

</details>


### [16] [DAGS: Disentangled Appearance-and-Geometry Steering of a Frozen Image DiT for Temporally Stabilized Generative Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02567)
*Karthik Mohan Kumar,Damian Andrysiak,Pedro Antonio Pena,Kunal Tyagi,Rama Harihara*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DAGS提出了一种轻量级、无注意力机制的解耦外观与几何条件化方案，通过在冻结的图像扩散模型中注入条件特征，实现高质量、高保真且独立可控的渲染。该方法采用两个小型卷积编码器计算每帧一次的条件特征，并以学习到的逐层元素残差形式注入图像令牌，避免了注意力机制带来的二次复杂度。由于控制和时间处理独立于冻结主干网络，保留了其大规模预训练先验并消除了主干过拟合风险。此外，引入小规模递归光照稳定器和无需训练的时间引导项，将单帧图像模型升级为流式渲染器。DAGS在计算成本远低于路径追踪的情况下实现了可控、高质量的渲染，虽非实时，但相比Intel OIDN和RGB<->X扩散渲染器，在相同1-spp+G-buffer输入下，重建PSNR提升8.6 dB/10.1 dB，且在时间稳定性上（时序LPIPS闪烁）提升2.5-8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散变压器（DiTs）在生成图像时存在输出方差大、对条件输入依赖性强的问题，难以实现精确控制与高保真渲染。尤其在视频流场景中，如何在保持高质量的同时实现高效、稳定、可控的渲染成为关键挑战。因此，亟需一种轻量、高效、解耦且能与冻结模型兼容的条件化机制，以提升渲染的可控性与稳定性。

Method: 提出DAGS框架，包含两个小型卷积编码器用于提取外观与几何条件特征，这些特征以学习的逐层元素残差形式注入图像令牌；摒弃注意力机制以降低计算开销；引入递归光照稳定器与训练-free时间引导项，增强时间一致性；所有控制逻辑独立于冻结主干，避免过拟合并保留预训练先验。

Result: 在1-spp+G-buffer输入条件下，DAGS相比Intel OIDN和RGB<->X扩散渲染器，分别提升8.6 dB和10.1 dB PSNR；在时间稳定性方面（使用temporal-LPIPS衡量），表现优于前者2.5至8倍；整体计算成本远低于路径追踪，虽非实时，但实现了高质量与高可控性的平衡。

Conclusion: DAGS成功将冻结的图像扩散模型转化为一个高效、可控、高保真的流式渲染器，通过解耦条件化设计与轻量模块集成，实现了在低计算开销下显著提升图像质量与时间稳定性，为基于扩散模型的高质量实时渲染提供了新范式。

Abstract: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate high-fidelity images from text and image conditions, but their outputs carry large variance and their faithfulness to a desired target depends heavily on how the condition is supplied. We present DAGS, a lightweight, attention-free, disentangled appearance and geometry conditioning scheme that steers a frozen image DiT to produce high-fidelity, highly faithful, and independently controllable renders. Two small convolutional encoders compute conditioning features once per frame and inject them as a learned, per-layer, element-wise residual into the image tokens, avoiding the quadratic cost of stacking conditions through attention. Because control and temporal handling live outside the frozen backbone, we retain its vast pretrained prior and eliminate backbone-overfitting risk. We further add a small recurrent lighting stabilizer and a training-free temporal guidance term that, coupled with our conditioning, elevate a per-frame image model into a streaming renderer. DAGS produces controllable, high-quality renders at a fraction of the compute of path tracing; it is not real-time, trading compute for controllability and quality. On a matched 1-spp + G-buffer input, per-frame DAGS reconstructs +8.6 dB / +10.1 dB PSNR over the real-time denoiser Intel OIDN and the diffusion renderer RGB<->X while being 2.5-8x more temporally stable perceptually (temporal-LPIPS flicker).

</details>

*Yuxing Wang,Yizhou Wang,Anqi Li,Shuo Wang,Sameer Satish Pusegaonkar,Haoquan Liang,Jiajun Li,Shenxin Jiang,Jianhe Yuan,Shangru Li,Tongwei Dai,Zihao Chen,David C. Anastasiu,Sujit Biswas,Xunlei Wu,Zheng Tang*

TL;DR: Physical AI Smart Spaces 是首个同时提供大规模、多类别、多摄像头 3D 感知数据的基准，涵盖超过 280 小时的同步 1080p 视频，来自近 1,800 个摄像头，覆盖仓库、医院、零售场所等场景。数据包含自动标注的多摄像头身份、2D/3D 边界框、相机校准及深度信息，并结合模拟生成、外观增强与真实世界评估。引入基于 VGGT 的自动校准与 3D 标注界面，支持跨摄像头验证。提出 3D 版本的 Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA) 评估指标，扩展了传统 2D 跟踪评估至 3D 空间。提供标准化提交格式与排行榜系统，并报告了从行人跟踪到多类 3D 框跟踪的基线性能。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 结合 Isaac Sim 合成生成、Cosmos Transfer 外观增强技术，构建仿真-真实迁移（Sim2Real）数据流；采用时间同步视频流与基于 VGGT 的自动相机校准方法；设计跨视角投影的 3D 标注接口以实现一致性验证；开发适用于多类目标的 3D HOTA 评估指标；建立标准化的提交与排行榜系统。

Result: 成功构建了包含超 280 小时、近 1,800 个摄像头的多视角 3D 感知数据集，支持多类别、多摄像头、高精度 3D 标注与评估；实现了真实场景中的自动校准与跨视图验证；提出并验证了 3D HOTA 指标的有效性；在 AI City Challenge 基线上展示了从单一人物跟踪向多类 3D 框跟踪演进的趋势。

Abstract: Physical AI Smart Spaces is, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark to simultaneously provide large-scale, multi-class, and multi-camera 3D perception data for indoor smart spaces. It contains over 280 hours of synchronized 1080p footage captured by nearly 1,800 cameras in warehouses, hospitals, retail venues, and similar settings, together with automatic annotations for multi-camera identities, 2D bounding boxes, 3D bounding boxes, camera calibration, and depth where available. The benchmark spans Isaac Sim synthetic generation, Cosmos Transfer appearance augmentation, and real-world Sim2Real evaluation. For the real-world target, we include two warehouse deployments with time-synchronized streams, automatic VGGT-based calibration, and a 3D labeling interface that projects world-frame 3D boxes into each view for cross-camera verification. We describe the dataset scope, annotation and calibration schema, generation workflow, benchmark protocols, and official evaluation system, which standardizes submission format, and leaderboard reporting. A central contribution is a 3D instantiation of Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA), extending the usual 2D box-based tracking evaluation to 3D locations and 3D boxes. We further report empirical baselines from the AI City Challenge leaderboards, showing how methods evolve from person-only 3D location tracking to multi-class 3D box tracking under realistic smart-space constraints. The release is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces.

</details>


### [18] [GRAFT: Growing Agglomerative Foundation Models via Continual Teacher Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02597)
*Zhenghao Zhao,Chi Zhang,Qingshuang Chen,Yelin Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GRAFT是一种持续的多教师知识蒸馏框架，允许统一的主干网络逐步从开放序列的基础模型中获取能力。当新教师到来时，GRAFT将先前蒸馏的模型作为教师以保留已学能力，同时当前学生联合学习先前模型和新教师的知识。为解决异构教师间表示几何不兼容问题，引入了教师特定读出令牌（Teacher Specific Readout Tokens）和几何无关关系损失（Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss），通过匹配图像-文本相似性结构而非原始特征值来对齐视觉语言教师。该方法实现了单个可持续扩展的主干模型，统一了五大领域：图像理解、2D密集预测、3D人体姿态估计、3D视觉和视觉语言，且在各领域表现优异，每次新增能力仅需一次蒸馏，无需全量重蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多教师知识蒸馏方法假设教师集合固定，新增教师需重新进行昂贵的联合蒸馏。为实现对开放序列基础模型的持续集成，需要一种能高效、低成本地融合新能力的框架。

Method: GRAFT采用持续学习策略，将先前蒸馏模型作为教师保留已有知识，新教师与旧模型共同指导当前学生学习；引入教师特定读出令牌实现各教师独立读出共享编码器，并使用几何无关关系损失对齐不同教师间的图像-文本相似性结构，缓解表示空间不一致问题。

Result: GRAFT模型成功构建了一个统一的可扩展主干网络，涵盖图像理解、2D密集预测、3D人体姿态估计、3D视觉和视觉语言五个领域，性能全面且稳定。新增每项能力仅需一次蒸馏训练，显著降低计算成本，避免重复全量蒸馏。

Conclusion: GRAFT提供了一种高效、可持续的多教师知识融合机制，解决了异构基础模型能力整合中的可扩展性与几何不一致难题，推动了通用视觉模型的发展。

Abstract: Vision foundation models such as DINOv2, SigLIP2, and MASt3R develop complementary capabilities from different pretraining objectives, yet their knowledge remains distributed across separate, specialized models. Multi-teacher knowledge distillation offers a path toward consolidating these capabilities into a single agglomerative backbone, but existing approaches assume a fixed set of teachers, and incorporating a new teacher requires repeating expensive joint distillation over the entire teacher set. We introduce GRAFT, a continual multi-teacher distillation framework that enables a unified backbone to progressively acquire capabilities from an open-ended sequence of foundation models. When a new teacher arrives, GRAFT treats the previously distilled model as a teacher for preserving learned capabilities, while the current student jointly learns from both the previous model and the incoming teacher. Furthermore, to reconcile the incompatible representation geometries of heterogeneous teachers, we introduce Teacher Specific Readout Tokens, which grant each teacher an independent read-out of the shared encoder, together with Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss that aligns a vision-language teacher by matching image-text similarity structures rather than raw feature values. We provide GRAFT model, which is a single, continually extensible backbone that unifies five domains, including image understanding, 2D dense prediction, 3D human pose estimation, 3D vision, and vision-language, delivering strong performance across all of them while acquiring each new capability at the cost of a single distillation rather than a full re-distillation.

</details>


### [19] [Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02626)
*Shenglan Li,Zhendong Mi,Hengyi Zhu,Jingwu Luo,Chun Kit Chan,Geng Yuan,Yanzhi Wang,Pu Zhao,Shaoyi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IG-VLA提出一种视觉-语言-动作模型推理框架，通过潜在时空推理在视觉表示空间中想象任务相关的未来场景演变，指导动作预测而不需昂贵的像素级视频生成。引入场景概要记忆（Scene Gist Memory），将推理得到的场景-行为关联压缩为紧凑的场景概要标记，避免推理时重复想象未来，显著降低计算开销。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和VLABench上的实验表明，该方法在成功率上优于最强基线近6%，且推理速度提升达6.38倍，从1081ms降至169.5ms每动作块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型多基于当前观测状态进行推理，缺乏对未来的显式预测；若在每个推理步骤中都进行未来推演，会带来巨大计算负担。因此需要一种既能保留未来推理优势，又能高效部署的方法。

Method: 提出IG-VLA框架，包含：1）潜在时空推理模块，在视觉表示空间中直接模拟未来场景演化；2）场景概要记忆机制，将推理过程中的关键场景-行为关联编码为紧凑的场景概要标记，实现未来推理的内部化。

Result: 在LIBERO-Plus语言任务集上，推理策略与概要策略分别比最强基线提升近6%的成功率；概要策略实现最高6.38倍加速，推理延迟从1081ms降至169.5ms（单A6000 GPU）。

Conclusion: 未来时空推理可被有效内化于VLA模型中，实现高性能与高效率的平衡，适用于实际机器人部署。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.

</details>


### [20] [Capturing Dynamics: The 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02647)
*Zesheng Wang,Alexandre Bruckert,Pierre Lebreton,Patrick Le Callet,Yante Li,Guoying Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出4D面部表情强度数据集（4DFEID），通过参数化人脸模型生成2,869个带控制几何变化的网格序列，结合众包平台收集超过90,000条主观强度感知评分。研究对比多种架构与聚合方法，发现时空图模型在片段强度估计上优于传统帧聚合方法。该数据集提供高保真、时空一致的动态3D刺激，填补了情感计算与人机交互中对自然表情分析的研究空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多基于2D静态图像进行面部表情强度检测，难以全面反映真实世界中本质为3D且时序连续的面部表情，因此需要更真实、动态的3D数据支持表情强度感知研究。

Method: 采用参数化人脸模型构建4D面部表情数据集，生成具有多样化峰值强度和身份属性的2,869个网格序列；通过Likert量表在众包平台上收集主观强度感知评分；测试多种网络架构与聚合策略以建立强度估计基线。

Result: 时空图模型在表情强度估计任务中表现优于传统方法；4DFEID数据集提供了高质量、动态、3D的面部表情数据，具备高度时空一致性，可推动更自然、细致的表情分析研究。

Conclusion: 4DFEID是首个基于动态3D数据的面部表情强度感知数据集，为情感计算与人机交互领域提供了关键资源，有助于实现更精准、自然的表情理解与交互设计。

Abstract: The estimation and analysis of facial expression intensity play a crucial role in affective communication and human-computer interaction. Previous research has primarily focused on detecting and estimating facial expression intensity from frame-level 2D representations. However, this limitation restricts a comprehensive understanding of real-world facial expressions, as they are inherently 3D and temporally continuous. This paper investigates the perception of facial expression intensity by introducing the 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset (4DFEID). We employ a parametric face model and compile a total of 2,869 mesh sequences with controlled geometric variations, generating 4D data instances with diverse peak intensities and identity attributes. Using a Likert scale, we collect more than 90,000 subjective intensity perception ratings via a crowdsourcing platform. We explore various architectures and aggregation methods to establish baselines for episode intensity estimation on the new dataset, revealing that spatial-temporal graph models consistently outperform traditional frame-aggregation methods. In contrast to existing datasets that rely on 2D static imagery, the proposed 4D-FEID dataset provides the community with a unique and vital resource for investigating the perception of facial expression intensity through the use of dynamic 3D stimuli. By offering high-fidelity, spatio-temporally coherent facial data, 4D-FEID establishes a new foundation for research into more nuanced and naturalistic expression analysis, thereby addressing a gap in the current landscape of affective computing and human-computer interaction studies. The dataset is available at link.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions, but a diffusion-based action expert (AE) poses a key challenge for low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ). We propose CHASE-VLA, a chunk-aware PTQ method that exploits a VLA-specific signal readily available from the policy: the generated action chunk, including its unexecuted future suffix. This enables W4A4 quantization of both MLP and attention projections in the repeated AE without modifying the pretrained policy. On LIBERO, CHASE-VLA achieves 97.3% average success rate on $π_{0.5}$ when both MLP and attention projections in the AE are quantized to W4A4, restoring FP16-level performance. CHASE-VLA also reduces the weight storage of the quantized AE linear layers by 73.4% and their single-chunk memory traffic by 70.9% and 71.2% on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.6, respectively, with a predictor overhead of at most 1.26% of the saved storage.

Abstract: Vision-language models such as CLIP exhibit strong semantic generalization, but remain limited in fine-grained visual perception. A recent work named KUEA presents a natural remedy by finetuning the image encoder under the supervision of the vision-centric DINOv2 to align their kernel matrices element-wisely, while regularizing the embeddings to remain close to the pretrained visual encoder for preserving image-text semantics in CLIP. In this work, we present a novel perspective to characterize representation alignment on feature subspaces through Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis (KCCA), which maximizes the projection correlations. Further, we extend our method into a 3-view formulation, i.e., 3vKCCA, in which the projections from the pretrained text encoder are also incorporated under a unified optimization framework for joint alignment. Abstract: Flow-matching-based multi-view world models generate realistic videos, but are commonly restricted to fixed camera rigs. Extending them to continuously varying camera poses requires paired pose--video observations with dense pose coverage, which are costly to acquire. We introduce \emph{SymRegFlow}, a symmetry-regularized flow-matching framework for multi-view-consistent video generation across continuous viewpoints without ground-truth novel-view RGB supervision. For each target pose, SymRegFlow geometrically warps source views into noisy anchors and combines masked dual-anchor supervision with cross-anchor denoising-output consistency to mitigate anchor-specific errors. Under an affine Gaussian surrogate, we prove that suitable consistency regularization recovers the clean-reference optimum at fixed noise levels, strictly outperforming single- and merged-anchor baselines. Experiments on Cosmos-Drive-Dreams and nuScenes demonstrate high-quality, multi-view-consistent autonomous-driving video generation: on nuScenes, SymRegFlow achieves the lowest FVD and FVMD among the evaluated baselines, reducing FVD by over 31\% relative to the best baseline, and source-conditioned inference also attains the best FID and instance preservation.

Abstract: The practical success of conditional image generation hinges on fine-grained differences in condition alignment and visual fidelity. Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is central to this success, but its lack of an explicit criterion makes it difficult to assess whether the guided trajectory is progressing as intended. To address this gap, we show that spectral alignment provides a principled criterion for understanding guidance behavior and improving guided diffusion sampling through adaptive correction. Our analysis identifies the spectra of intermediate states as an indicator of consistency with the expected spectral evolution of the forward process. Based on this observation, we introduce Spectral Correction Guidance, a method that corrects deviations from an analytic reference spectrum during sampling. The proposed method is training-free and applicable across diffusion backbones and conditional generation tasks without modifying the underlying model. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains in preference-based metrics over baseline guidance methods in text-to-image generation and improved generation quality over CFG on ImageNet. These improvements persist across a range of guidance scales and with fewer denoising steps. Our analyses and ablations provide insight into guidance behavior and how the proposed method affects generation quality.

Abstract: The superficial white matter (SWM), a critical brain region for cognition across the lifespan and brain disease, contains abundant short-range association fibers whose organization remains incompletely characterized, in part because the short trajectories and highly variable cortical folding make correspondence across individuals challenging. Anatomically corresponding connections may vary in spatial location across individuals and therefore may not be adequately defined by geometric proximity alone. We introduce FiberGeoText (FGT), a vision-language model (VLM) for organizing short-range superficial white matter (SWM) streamlines reconstructed from ultra-high-resolution diffusion MRI into population-level clusters. FGT jointly represents three complementary properties of each streamline: its three-dimensional trajectory, its cortical anatomical context, and its shape. Cortical endpoint information from multiple parcellation schemes is expressed as text and encoded using a pretrained large language model (LLM), enabling heterogeneous anatomical descriptions to contribute to a common continuous representation. We evaluated FGT on acquired submillimeter 0.76 mm diffusion MRI data. Compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, FGT produced substantially greater cortical parcel coherence, within-cluster shape consistency, cluster-size consistency, and cross-subject correspondence. The trained model also generalizes well to unseen subjects with an average of 96.7% of the 5,000 learned clusters recovered, and high consistency of cluster structure between training and testing data. Together, these findings demonstrate that integrating geometric, anatomical, and shape information by learning multimodal deep embeddings with a VLM model enables robust learning of population-consistent SWM organization despite interindividual anatomical variability.

### [27] [TRAC: Trajectory-aware Reuse and Adaptive Correction for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02779)

Method: TRAC包含三个关键组件：鲁棒累积调度（RCS）根据累积滚动误差和跨块/提示变化选择缓存重用策略；自回归轨迹感知引导调度（ATGS）沿全局自回归轨迹协调分类引导频率刷新；频谱结构校正（SSC）恢复首块的低频结构以修正长期结构损失。

Abstract: In this paper, we present trajectory-aware reuse and adaptive correction (TRAC), a training-free framework for efficient autoregressive (AR) video generation. Existing acceleration methods mainly target single-trajectory generation with bidirectional attention. AR video generation, by contrast, sequentially couples chunk-level denoising trajectories. Consequently, approximation errors accumulate and propagate through the generation process. TRAC addresses this challenge with three components, including robust cumulative scheduling (RCS), autoregressive trajectory-aware guidance scheduling (ATGS), and spectral structure correction (SSC). RCS selects cache reuse schedules by cumulative rollout error and cross-chunk/prompt variation. ATGS coordinates CFG refreshes along the global AR trajectory. SSC restores low-frequency structure of the first chunk to correct long-term structural loss. Experiments on SkyReels-V2 and FramePack-F1 show that, compared with existing methods, TRAC achieves both the highest inference efficiency and the best generation quality for AR video generation.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: A multimodal large language model that correctly reports a spatial fact does not necessarily use that fact in subsequent reasoning.   <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 提出一种配对协议：分别评估仅基于页面图像与结合图像和提取文本的问答表现；构建FoveDoc-Bench基准，支持可追溯证据；通过控制变量分析文本提取、图像裁剪、框选等不同条件下的性能变化；在多个VLM上验证结果的一致性与趋势。

*Haoyang Luo,Linwei Tao,Jie Gui,Xinghao Chen,Chang Xu,Jianyuan Guo,Minjing Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Causal-Invariant Masking (CIM)框架，通过测量原始预测与因果聚焦视图下预测之间的语义变化，实现对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中不确定性类型的分解。引入语义分歧作为核心度量指标，并理论证明其可捕捉模型对非因果关联的敏感性方差，从而有效识别由模型局限引起的认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）。进一步提出快速几何代理指标Expected Embedding Drift (EED)，在超球面嵌入空间中直接估计语义漂移，显著提升评估速度近50%，同时保持良好性能。实验表明该方法在多个基准上达到领先效果。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from hallucinations, creating a critical need for Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) to ensure reliable deployment. Abstract: We study how to consolidate the current VITOK progress into a single multi-teacher distillation recipe that jointly preserves global recognition and dense semantics. Abstract: Recent text-to-image models have made substantial progress in photorealism, aesthetics, and text-image alignment. Yet visually appealing images can still violate real-world plausibility, exhibiting malformed object structures, impossible anatomy, physically implausible interactions, or inconsistent spatial relationships. Such failures are not well captured by existing fidelity, aesthetics, preference, or alignment metrics. To address this gap, we introduce TerraVis, a framework for evaluating world-grounded visual consistency in generated images. TerraVis defines a structured taxonomy of world-consistency violations spanning object-, interaction-, and scene-level failures, and employs a multi-stage evaluation framework to identify and quantify them. Given an image, TerraVis first uses an MLLM to assess its eligibility for evaluation, then detects violations across 18 taxonomy-defined types and classifies them as minor or major to derive an overall world-consistency score. Across diverse open-source and proprietary text-to-image models on two widely used benchmarks, TerraVis achieves the strongest correlation with human judgments of world consistency among existing metrics. Our benchmark results further show that models that achieve strong performance on conventional metrics can still exhibit substantial world-consistency failures. These findings highlight world consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension and demonstrate that TerraVis enables systematic quantification, diagnosis, and comparison of such failures. </details>

Abstract: Recent text-to-image generation models have achieved remarkable visual quality, but improving them through post-training remains challenging because no single reward signal captures the full range of human preference. In this work, we develop a simple and effective post-training recipe for open-domain text-to-image generation based on the composition of complementary reward signals. Our reward system consists of two main components: a preference reward, trained on large-scale human preference data using a Bradley-Terry objective to capture overall human aesthetic and perceptual preferences, and rubric-based rewards, which explicitly evaluate prompt faithfulness and other desirable properties while providing safeguards against reward hacking. A key challenge is how to combine these heterogeneous reward signals. We show that a naive weighted average leads to suboptimal optimization behavior, and propose a simple reward composition strategy that more effectively balances preference optimization with rubric satisfaction. In the Arena text-to-image leaderboard (https://arena.ai/), our RL-trained Flux2dev achieves an Elo rating 69 points above the base model, and our post-trained Ideogram-4 surpasses every open-source model on the leaderboard, reaching an Elo of 1223.5. (Claims of state-of-the-art performance are based on the Arena leaderboard snapshot as of September 4, 2026.) Our results suggest that effective rewards for frontier generative-model training require broad coverage of user intent and robustness to exploitation under optimization. To support reproducible research, we release Arena-T2I-Training, a 1K subset of training data that recovers some gains of full-scale training, providing a resource that we hope will facilitate future work on post-training for text-to-image models.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大多数人体运动生成方法将运动编码为均匀时间网格上的标记，每个标记覆盖相同的时间窗口。然而，人体运动具有时间异质性：缓慢演变的全局轨迹与快速瞬态事件（如脚部接触、关节冲击）共存。将这种多尺度动态强制映射到相同时间分辨率的标记上，会导致运动频率混淆，使慢速区域冗余，同时模糊快速细节，影响真实感。因此需要一种能分离多尺度动态并保持时间精度的表示方法。

Method: 提出FreqMo，利用小波变换将运动分解为多个频率带，实现跨时间尺度的动力学分离；引入统一频率残差量化（UFRQ），将所有频率带编码进一个共享码本中，提升压缩效率并支持单阶段生成。

Result: 实验结果显示，FreqMo在运动生成保真度上达到当前最优（SOTA），尤其在高频率细节保留方面表现优异；该频率分解策略可成功迁移至连续扩散模型后端，具备良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: FreqMo通过频率自适应分解与统一量化机制，有效解决了传统均匀时间网格表示中的多尺度动态纠缠问题，实现了更高效、更真实的运动生成，为后续研究提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Most human motion generation methods encode motion as tokens on a uniform temporal grid, where every token spans the same fixed time window. Human motion, however, is temporally heterogeneous: slowly evolving global trajectories coexist with rapid transient events such as foot contacts and joint impulses. Forcing such multi-scale dynamics onto tokens of identical temporal resolution entangles motion frequencies, leaving slow regions redundant while smoothing out the rapid details that distinguish realistic motion. We propose \textbf{FreqMo}, a scale-adaptive motion representation that decomposes motion into wavelet frequency bands, separating dynamics across temporal scales while preserving temporal localization and exact reconstruction. Unified Frequency Residual Quantization (UFRQ) then encodes all bands within a single shared codebook, compressing the token sequence threefold and enabling stable single-stage generation. Experiments show FreqMo attains SOTA fidelity with substantially improved high-frequency preservation, and the same decomposition transfers to continuous diffusion backbones.

</details>

Abstract: Category-level object pose estimation predicts the rotation, translation, and metric size of unseen instances within known categories. Many accurate RGB-D methods rely on external instance segmentation and crop-based pose estimation, introducing separate stages and object-dependent processing costs that hinder real-time inference. It jointly detects and segments objects and estimates their \mbox{9-DoF} poses without explicit CAD-derived shape priors or a separately trained instance segmentor. A query-conditioned geometry pathway associates observed 3D points and RGB features with object queries and incorporates shared scene context. Object-centric refinement uses the resulting point descriptors to update an explicit pose state through pose-conditioned cross-attention and recurrent residual corrections. TL;DR: OmniAct3D提出一种框架，将基于透视图训练的视觉基础模型（VFM）检测器适配到等距投影（ERP）图像上，以实现对全景场景的准确3D检测。通过ERGA-Ray解决几何失配问题，通过VARC在全局场景中定位证据并生成结构化几何动作，通过AGHE恢复因固定令牌预算丢失的局部特征，显著提升检测性能，在Spheriverse和PanoMMOcc数据集上分别取得2.96 NDS点和24.87 mAP点的改进。该方法支持跨感知配置的可复用3D推理，代码将公开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型在长视频生成时面临漂移问题，即颜色、纹理偏移和运动动态衰减；虽然已有方法采用KV条件化缓解此问题，但其假设缓存的键值对始终在分布内，而实际中由于生成过程无约束，缓存条目可能变得分布外（OOD），形成‘KV来源’问题，因此需要一种新方法确保缓存与条件化均在训练配置下保持分布内。

Method: 提出In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing)框架，核心为自缓存机制：在每一段生成时，仅基于当前输入进行缓存，不关注之前的缓存条目，从而保证滚动窗口中的缓存始终处于训练分布内。该机制在测试阶段实现，无需修改模型结构或训练流程，可无缝扩展短时模型至分钟级视频生成。

Result: 在多个标准视频生成基准上，该方法保持了与现有方法相当的性能，同时在抑制视频漂移方面显著优于之前的工作。通过自定义的漂移度量和用户研究验证，其生成视频在视觉一致性与运动连贯性上均有明显提升。

Conclusion: ID-Forcing通过引入自缓存机制，有效解决了长视频生成中的KV-provenance问题，使现有短时视频生成模型能够稳定生成高质量的分钟级视频，是实现长时视频生成的重要进展。

Abstract: Modern autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models excel at short-horizon video generation, yet generating long videos remains challenging due to drifting, where colors and textures shift, and motion dynamics decay. Existing works primarily rely on KV conditioning, which selects or modifies cached key-value (KV) entries to mitigate drifting. However, we observe that KV conditioning alone is insufficient as it assumes cached KV entries remain in-distribution. This assumption fails beyond the training horizon: nothing constrains the construction of KV entries during rollout, giving rise to the KV-provenance problem where cached entries themselves become out-of-distribution (OOD). To address this, we propose In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing), a test-time framework that aligns both KV caching and KV conditioning with training configurations. Its key mechanism, self-caching, prevents OOD KV entries at their source. Each chunk is cached without attending to prior KV entry, keeping the rolling window exactly in-distribution. Consequently, ID-Forcing seamlessly extends short-horizon models to minute-scale video generation. Extensive evaluations show that our method remains competitive on standard video generation benchmark while substantially outperforming prior work in mitigating drifting, as validated by both our drift metrics and a user study.

</details>

Method: 提出 FORESIGHT 双流架构：两个共享权重的 Siamese LLMs，一主一辅；主模型持续处理输入，辅模型超前运行以预测未来、规划计算（包括何时推理、检查什么、采样密度），并通过分离临时证据与持久控制实现独立管理；采用方案引导解码与基于差异的轻量更新协议，实现高效在线重配置。

Result: 使用冻结的 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干网络，FORESIGHT 在 OmniPro Online 上达到 23.0 的平均联合 F1，比最强训练基线高 9.5%；在 StreamingBench 和 OVO-Bench 上分别提升 6.7 和 15.4，尤其在证据延迟出现时提升达 18.7%，证明其在动态场景中具有强大适应性。

Conclusion: FORESIGHT 成功实现了无需训练的前瞻性计算，使流式视觉语言模型能够根据未来预期动态调节计算策略，显著提升性能且开销极低，为智能视频理解提供了新范式。

Abstract: Existing streaming vision-language models (VLMs) continuously perceive and reason over visual streams, but their computational pathways remain fixed throughout inference. Consequently, they cannot adapt computation to evolving scene dynamics, where different future events demand different levels and forms of perception. We show that streaming VLMs inherently possess the ability to anticipate the immediate future, and leverage this capability to dynamically configure future computation in a training-free manner. Realizing such anticipatory computation, however, is very challenging: future anticipation must be sufficiently reliable to guide computation, planning must run concurrently with streaming inference, and online reconfiguration must incur negligible overhead. To address these challenges, we introduce FORESIGHT, a dual-stream architecture comprising two Siamese LLMs with shared weights, input encoders, and KV cache. The first LLM continuously processes incoming tokens, while the second runs ahead of the stream to anticipate future context, plan future computation, and generate task responses without interrupting streaming inference. Each plan decides when to reason next, what to check then, and how densely to sample, keeping transient evidence separate from persistent control. The resulting computation plan is executed online through an efficient reconfiguration protocol with schemaguided decoding and lightweight diff-based updates, enabling dynamic adaptation with low overhead. With a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, FORESIGHT achieves 23.0 mean joint F1 on OmniPro Online evaluation beating strongest trained baseline by 9.5%, while improving the backbone by 6.7 on StreamingBench and 15.4 on OVO-Bench, with the largest gain of 18.7 when evidence arrives later in the video stream. Our source code will be made publicly available.

</details>

*Zhaolu Kang,Shiyu Liu,Tailong Luo,Wei Zhang,Yingjie He,Lei Wei,Guansu Wang,Liang He,Siheng Wang,Guangyuan Dong,Jiaqi Su,Shuang Chen,Haoyu Ji,Qishi Zhan,Kaiyue Zhou*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视频多模态大语言模型虽然在问答任务上表现优异，但其预测高度依赖外观和语言先验，而非真实的时间证据。原因在于后训练阶段仅基于单一响应进行奖励，导致模型无法在不同视角间保持一致性。因此需要一种新的训练范式，使模型能够基于证据进行推理，而非依赖表面线索。

Method: 提出行为包优化（BPO），将传统的单次响应替换为针对不同问题类型选择的反事实视图集合（行为包），并对整个包内的输出进行联合评分。评分标准包括：无关干预下保持稳定、关键证据移除时敏感、无证据时合理弃答。采用锚定相对优势机制，以原始视图为参考，避免因混合视图带来的统计偏差，提升小包规模下的训练稳定性。

Result: 在TempCompass、MVBench、NExT-QA等数据集上，BPO使Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的宏观准确率提升4.7个百分点，时间困难子集提升7.8个百分点，弃答F1提升20.0个百分点。该方法在Video-MME、LongVideoBench及LLaVA-Video-7B上也表现出良好迁移性。消融实验验证了性能提升源于对视图集合的设计，而非单纯增加采样次数。

Conclusion: BPO提供了一种新的多视角联合评估范式，推动视频多模态大模型向基于证据的推理演进。该方法在不增加计算预算的前提下显著提升模型对时间线索的敏感性和可靠性，为未来多模态后训练研究提供了有效起点。

Abstract: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) keep climbing video question answering benchmarks, yet shuffling the frames, masking the segment that supports the answer, or occluding the target object barely changes their predictions. The accuracy rests on appearance and language priors, not on the temporal evidence the question asks for. We trace this to the unit of post-training: rewards are computed on a single response to the original clip, so the model is never asked to behave consistently across views. We propose Behavior Pack Optimization (BPO), which replaces the single response with a behavior pack of outputs across counterfactual views chosen by question type, scored jointly. The pack reward asks for stability when the intervention is irrelevant, sensitivity when key evidence is removed, and abstention when no evidence remains. To keep this objective stable at small pack sizes, BPO uses an anchor-relative advantage: the response on the original view serves as a per-prompt reference instead of a group mean over mixed views. On TempCompass, MVBench, and NExT-QA, BPO improves the macro accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct by 4.7 pp, the temporal-hard subset by 7.8 pp, and abstention F1 by 20.0 pp over a budget-matched vanilla GRPO baseline from the same SFT checkpoint. We hope this pack-level perspective offers a useful starting point for the video MLLM and multimodal post-training community as the field moves toward evidence-grounded video reasoning.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Deep neural networks remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, which can distort not only predictions but also confidence scores, undermining uncertainty calibration. While existing certification methods focus on preserving the predicted category, providing guarantees on how calibration behaves under adversarial attacks remains overlooked. In this work, we introduce CalCErt, a simple and efficient post-hoc strategy that certifies bin-wise confidence calibration for any pretrained differentiable classifier. Our approach combines empirical calibration estimates, statistical concentration bounds, and local Lipschitz estimates of the confidence function to derive data-dependent upper bounds on worst-case miscalibration within an $ell_2$-ball of radius R. We evaluate CalCErt across 11 medical image classification tasks and multiple adversarial perturbations, demonstrating substantially higher certified coverage than baseline strategies while maintaining competitive tightness. Our code is available at https://github.com/leofillioux/calcert.

</details>


### [54] [Does Physics Live in the Activations? Localizing Physical Quantities in Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03154)
*Jonas Kneifl,Jakub Skalski,Bartłomiej Twardowski,Kamil Deja*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过探测视频扩散变换器（DiTs）内部表示中由模拟器生成的真实物理量，发现这些物理信息在去噪过程早期即可高精度线性解码，表明物理信息是在去噪过程中主动构建的，而非初始输入中已存在。此外，物体相关标记携带关键物理信息，多帧量可从单帧潜在表示中读取，说明信息在序列中高度局部化但全局计算、局部存储。探针还表现出部分外推能力，能泛化到训练范围外的场景和物体配置，表明其捕捉的是真正的物理规律而非简单相关性。在全分辨率激活空间中，探测方向可作为控制向量调节模型输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能生成逼真视频，但在物理推理方面仍存在明显缺陷。研究旨在探究这些模型是否真正内化了物理原理，还是仅复制熟悉运动模式。

Method: 通过设计探针分析视频扩散变换器（DiTs）在去噪过程中的内部表示，解码来自模拟器的物理量（如运动学、刚体动力学），评估其在不同阶段的可读性，并测试其在不同场景下的泛化能力。

Result: 物理量可在去噪早期被高精度线性解码，优于直接从噪声潜变量解码的基线；物体标记承载物理信息，多帧信息可从单帧读取；探针具有部分外推能力，且在全分辨率空间中可作为控制向量调节模型输出。

Conclusion: 视频生成模型并非简单记忆运动模式，而是通过去噪过程主动构建物理信息，且这些信息在内部表示中局部化存储并具备一定泛化能力，表明其对物理规律有一定程度的内化。

Abstract: Video generation models produce strikingly realistic sequences and are increasingly proposed as world models, yet recent benchmarks reveal pronounced deficits in their physical reasoning. This raises the question of whether these models internalize physical principles or merely reproduce familiar motion patterns. We address this by probing internal representations of video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for simulator-derived ground-truth physical quantities spanning kinematic motion and rigid-body dynamics under gravity and contact. We find that these quantities are linearly decodable with high accuracy early in the denoising process, substantially outperforming a baseline decoded directly from the model's own noised latents, indicating that the relevant physical information is actively constructed during denoising rather than already present in the input. Additionally, we show that activations at on-object tokens carry the relevant physical information and that quantities defined over multiple frames are readable from single latent frames. Hence, information is sharply localized within the token sequence and is computed globally but stored locally. The probes further show partial extrapolation, transferring to scene variations and object configurations outside their training regime, so what they read is not simply a correlate of the scenes they were fit on. When fitted directly in the full-resolution activation space, the probing directions can serve as steering vectors to change the model's output.

</details>


### [55] [Geometry-Aligned Semantic Matching for Cross-Modal Planar Image Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03167)
*Zhiwei Wang,Defeng He,Yuxing Li,Meilu Zhu,Edmund Y. Lam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CDPM方法，通过几何一致的语义表示与多尺度特征金字塔结合，实现跨模态图像匹配中的稳定且精确的对应关系估计。在多个数据集上表现优于现有方法，尤其在VIS-IR数据集上显著提升匹配精度并降低计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法中，语义相似性不等同于几何对应，而细粒度CNN特征缺乏全局跨模态语义指导，导致匹配不稳定。需要同时兼顾语义一致性与局部细节精度。

Method: 采用渐进式DINOv3适应几何一致的跨模态块对，构建DINO-Centric特征金字塔，融合多尺度DINO语义信息与轻量级CNN结构细节，以保持跨模态对应稳定性并实现精细定位。

Result: 在三个跨模态数据集上实验验证，尤其在VIS-IR数据集上相比RoMa提升AUC@3/5/10/20达7.36、13.40、13.75、10.42个百分点，mACE从5.83降至2.78像素，且仅需45.6%的FLOPs。

Conclusion: CDPM通过融合几何一致的语义表示与细粒度局部特征，在跨模态图像匹配任务中实现了更高精度与效率，具有实际应用潜力。

Abstract: Cross-modal image matching establishes stable and accurate geometric correspondences across modalities for planar registration. Existing semantic representations provide cross-modal consistency, but semantic similarity does not necessarily imply geometric correspondence. Meanwhile, fine-grained CNN features provide accurate local details but lack global cross-modal semantic guidance for stable refinement. To address these issues, we propose CDPM, which first establishes geometrically consistent semantic representations and then preserves their dominant role in correspondence estimation during fine-grained localization. Specifically, we progressively adapt DINOv3 using geometrically consistent cross-modal patch pairs, enabling feature similarity to better reflect true cross-modal spatial correspondences. We then construct a DINO-Centric Feature Pyramid, where multi-scale DINO representations maintain stable cross-modal correspondences, while a lightweight CNN branch provides auxiliary structural details for precise local refinement. Extensive experiments on three cross-modal datasets demonstrate the superior performance of CDPM. On VIS-IR, compared with the dense matcher RoMa, CDPM improves AUC@3/5/10/20 by 7.36, 13.40, 13.75, and 10.42 percentage points, respectively, and reduces mACE from 5.83 to 2.78 pixels. It also outperforms RoMa v2 across all metrics while requiring 45.6% fewer FLOPs. The online demo and dataset are available, and the code will be released on our project page at https://warren-wzw.github.io/CDPM/.

</details>


### [56] [PocketSplat: Mobile Gaussian Reconstruction via World-Space Latent Allocatio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03192)
*Wenzhi Guo,Xianda Chen,Dongxuan Chen,Guangchi Fang,Bing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PocketSplat 是一种面向移动设备的预算受限高斯资产构建框架，通过在世界空间中组织密集的几何感知潜在候选，精确分配局部潜在单元的整数容量，并仅对保留的候选解码完整的高斯属性，实现了高效且高质量的重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈高斯重建方法通常解码密集且与图像对齐的候选，其最终基数由输入分辨率和视角数量隐式决定，难以满足移动设备的资源约束和下游应用的表示大小需求。因此需要一种能够在有限资源下生成紧凑且高质量高斯资产的方法。

Method: PocketSplat 通过预测的世界空间组织密集的几何感知潜在候选，采用基于单元的潜在融合聚合多视角证据，并通过空间责任解码在局部稀疏化后自适应调整高斯支持范围，实现精确的容量分配和高效的属性解码。

Result: 在DL3DV和分布外基准测试中，PocketSplat 在质量-预算权衡上显著优于现有前馈高斯重建基线；在Mip-NeRF 360上，其可在目标iPhone上直接运行，比可部署的流式MVSplat变体更快地构建更紧凑、更高质量的高斯资产，而原生MVSplat和DepthSplat则超出设备内存预算。

Conclusion: PocketSplat 成功实现了在移动设备上的高效、高质量高斯资产构建，在资源受限环境下展现出优越性能，为移动端三维重建提供了可行解决方案。

Abstract: Mobile Gaussian reconstruction must satisfy two requirements: the reconstruction model must execute within a device resource envelope, and the resulting Gaussian asset must expose a representation size suited to downstream mobile use. Existing feed-forward Gaussian reconstructors commonly decode dense, image-aligned candidates whose final cardinality is implicitly determined by the input resolution and number of views. We present PocketSplat, a feed-forward framework for budgeted mobile Gaussian asset construction. Given a prescribed output budget, PocketSplat organizes dense geometry-aware latent candidates in predicted world space, allocates exact integer capacity across local latent cells, and decodes complete Gaussian attributes only for retained candidates. Cell-conditioned latent fusion aggregates repeated multi-view evidence before decoding, while spatial responsibility decoding adapts Gaussian support after local sparsification. Experiments on DL3DV and out-of-distribution benchmarks establish a strong quality--budget trade-off against feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction baselines. On Mip-NeRF 360, PocketSplat executes directly on a target iPhone and constructs compact, higher-quality Gaussian assets substantially faster than a deployable streamed MVSplat variant; native MVSplat and DepthSplat exceed the device memory budget.

</details>


### [57] [Bridging Research and Practice: A Systematic Evaluation of Generalist and Dermatology-Specific Models in Clinical Skin Lesion Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03193)
*Emanoel dos Santos,Kelvin Cunha,Rodrigo Mota,Fabio Papais,Thales Bezerra,Natalia Lopes,Erico Medeiros,Shirley Cruz,Jessica Araujo,Paulo Borba,Tsang Ing Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究系统评估了多种机器学习模型在皮肤科图像上的泛化能力，涵盖皮肤镜和智能手机拍摄的临床照片，重点分析了通用和医学视觉-语言模型、基础模型与专用皮肤科分类器的表现差异。研究关注模型在分布偏移、模态变化和人口统计学差异下的鲁棒性，旨在揭示当前先进模型与临床部署需求之间的差距，推动可靠、可及且临床适用的AI系统发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床皮肤科诊断存在高度不确定性，皮肤病变表现出显著变异性，受成像模态、设备质量及患者人群差异影响，阻碍了鲁棒AI模型的开发，亟需系统评估模型在异质数据中的泛化能力以支持实际应用。

Method: 对多种架构（包括通用/医学视觉-语言模型、基础模型、嵌入式方法、卷积神经网络等）在近期皮肤科数据集上进行基准测试，评估其在分布偏移、模态变化和人口统计学多样性条件下的性能表现。

Result: 发现当前最先进的模型在面对数据分布变化、成像模态转换和不同人群时仍存在显著性能下降，表明现有模型距离安全、公平的临床部署仍有较大差距。

Conclusion: 为实现可靠的临床级AI系统，需进一步提升模型在真实世界异质数据中的鲁棒性和泛化能力，强调系统性评估与跨域验证的重要性。

Abstract: The application of machine learning to dermatology has grown substantially in recent years, moving beyond proof-of-concept studies toward potential applications. However, clinical dermatology remains a challenging and still open problem. Diagnostic assessment is often ambiguous, and skin lesions exhibit high variability, compounded by differences in acquisition modality, device quality, and patient demographics. These factors hinder the development of robust models suitable for safe and equitable clinical use. To support translation into practice, it is essential to systematically evaluate how contemporary models generalize across heterogeneous data sources. In this work, we benchmark a diverse set of architectures on recent dermatology datasets, spanning dermoscopic images and smartphone-based clinical photographs. We assess the robustness of recent general-purpose and medical vision-language models, as well as foundation models, and compare them against task-specific dermatology classifiers, including embedding-based approaches and convolutional neural networks. Our study provides an evaluation of model performance under distribution shifts, modality changes, and demographic variability. By quantifying the gap between current state-of-the-art models and the requirements of clinical deployment, we aim to contribute to the development of reliable, accessible, and clinically applicable AI systems for dermatology.

</details>


### [58] [Contextual Flow Matching: Adaptive Step Selection in Flow Models for Efficient Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03202)
*Divya Jyoti Bajpai,Arun Verma,Manjesh Kumar Hanawal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: COFLOW是一种推理时自适应步数选择方法，基于提示特征动态调整生成过程中的步数，实现高效且高质量的视觉生成。该方法无需重新训练模型，可广泛应用于图像和视频生成任务，提升超过2.5倍速度，同时保持感知与语义质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
